definition: Reuse frozen PR5 independent endpoint and complex-step J. Sigma=diag((.001scale)^2,(.002scale)^2), P=J Sigma Jt; marginal inclusive abs(hT/vT-nominal)<=1.959963984540054sqrt(Pkk). acceptance: All36 archived hashes and4096rows/combinations exact;72coverages exact;72bias within1e-12; both semantic mutants rejected; no ambiguous numerical boundary; total fail-closed.
